rows.grounds: compound adjective describing the subject as released from every sin; formed from sarva (all), pāpa (sin), and vinirmukta (freed)
compound object denoting extended lifespan; dīrgha (long) qualifying āyus (life)
demonstrative pronoun referring to the practitioner described in the preceding context
present active verb expressing attainment of the stated result

items.question: What purification and longevity does the duly authorized practitioner attain?
premises: The practitioner is freed from all sins.
This attainment follows the previously authorized ritual practice.
items.inference: Properly authorized ritual practice results in complete purification and extended lifespan.
uncertainties: The subject's identity is supplied by the immediately preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Freed from all sins, he obtains a long life.
